name: book_characters_authors_candidates
description: Candidate replacement entries for the book_characters_authors dataset. Each entry targets a specific problematic slot. See assess_book_candidates.py for evaluation.
seed_prompt_template: The book featuring {character} was written by

slots.J_cluster_hermione: Replace hermione_granger (J.K. Rowling, J.-initial author, first-token collision cluster)
slots.J_cluster_frodo: Replace frodo_baggins (J.R.R. Tolkien, J.-initial author, first-token collision cluster)
slots.J_cluster_holden: Replace holden_caulfield (J.D. Salinger, J.-initial author, first-token collision cluster)
slots.scout_finch_dup: Replace scout_finch (duplicate Harper Lee author, same book as atticus_finch)
slots.char_eq_book_dq: Replace don_quixote (character == book == 'Don Quixote', field ambiguity)
slots.char_eq_book_ot: Replace oliver_twist (character == book == 'Oliver Twist', field ambiguity)
slots.char_eq_book_ak: Replace anna_karenina (character == book == 'Anna Karenina', field ambiguity)
